# MuzMesh brand rules for AI

<!-- Generated by docs/brand/build-tokens.mjs from ai/brand.src.md. Do not edit by hand. -->

You are making something for **MuzMesh**: a web page, a section, a social post, a deck, a document, an email or copy. Follow every rule in this file. When a request conflicts with these rules, follow the rules and say which rule you followed. When something is not covered, choose the plainest option that uses only the values listed here.

Brand version v2 · Nov 2026. Every colour, size and font below is generated from the same token file the live website uses, so these values are exact.

## 1. The idea in one paragraph

MuzMesh is the design partner for AI startups: brand, landing page and launch kit, designed by people, ready in five days. The brand has to look **launched, not generated**. That means a black page, warm off-white text, one orange used sparingly, one typeface, mono labels, and real work shown in browser windows. No glowing orbs, no gradients on text, no sparkle icons, no robots.

Personality: considered, plain-spoken, quietly confident, founder-to-founder.

## 2. The ten rules that matter most

1. Background is pure black `#000000` (Launch theme). Documents, proposals and invoices use the light Paper theme `#F3F0E8`.
2. Text on black is bone `#F4F4F1`, never pure white. Text on paper is ink `#1D1D1F`.
3. There is exactly one accent colour: signal orange `#F2580F`. Use it for the one primary button per view, the small square before a label, a live dot, a focus ring or a single full stop. Never as a large background, never on body text, never as a gradient on text.
4. Text and icons on an orange fill are always `#0E0E10` (dark), never white.
5. One typeface for all text: **Inter Tight** (400, 500, 600, 700). **JetBrains Mono** (400, 500) only for UPPERCASE labels, data, numbers in tables and timestamps. No other fonts.
6. Headlines are two-tone: the setup in a dim grey, the payoff in full bone. Example: Every AI startup looks the same. Yours won’t.
7. Every section starts with a mono UPPERCASE label with a 5px orange square before it.
8. Square = label or list item. Circle = something live (a status dot).
9. No emoji, no sparkle or “AI” symbols, no stock 3D, no robots or glowing brains. Generated images follow the prompt library in section 8 and are never presented as real people or real work.
10. Copy is short, exact and true. No invented numbers, testimonials or client logos.

## 4. Type

Load: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap`

| Style | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing | Font | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| display | clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 72px) | 500 | 1.02 | -0.035em | Inter Tight | One per page. Hero headline. |
| h2 | clamp(34px, 3.7vw, 56px) | 500 | 1.04 | -0.03em | Inter Tight | Section headline. Two-tone allowed: dim the first part with .mm-dim. |
| h3 | clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px) | 500 | 1.08 | -0.025em | Inter Tight | Sub-section headline, closing lines, big quotes. |
| h4 | 22px | 600 | 1.2 | -0.015em | Inter Tight | Card and panel titles. |
| stat | clamp(44px, 4.6vw, 64px) | 500 | 1 | -0.04em | Inter Tight | Big numbers: $500, 5 days, 40%. Always tabular figures. |
| lead | clamp(17px, 1.35vw, 20px) | 400 | 1.5 | -0.01em | Inter Tight | Paragraph under a headline. Max 40ch. Colour --mm-text-muted. |
| body-lg | 17px | 400 | 1.5 | -0.01em | Inter Tight | Long reading, FAQ questions and answers, form fields. |
| body | 15px | 400 | 1.55 | 0 | Inter Tight | Default text. |
| button | 16px | 600 | 1 | -0.01em | Inter Tight | Button labels. Small buttons are 14px, same weight. |
| ui | 14px | 400 | 1.45 | 0 | Inter Tight | Nav links, chips, table cells, list items in panels. |
| small | 13px | 400 | 1.45 | 0 | Inter Tight | Captions, helper text, footnotes. Never smaller for sans text. |
| label | 11.5px | 400 | 1.2 | 0.06em | JetBrains Mono | UPPERCASE eyebrow with the orange square bullet. |
| micro | 10.5px | 500 | 1.2 | 0.12em | JetBrains Mono | UPPERCASE ticket fields, table heads, tags. |
| data | 12px | 400 | 1.5 | 0 | JetBrains Mono | Timestamps, URLs, build logs, code. Mixed case, never tracked. |
| wordmark | 22px | 700 | 1 | -0.015em | Inter Tight | Text wordmark in the nav. Lowercase. The only 700 in the system. |

Take size, weight, line height and letter spacing together from one style. Never mix them.

**Tracking follows size.** One letter-spacing value per size, tighter as type gets bigger. Mono is never tracked negative; lowercase is never tracked positive.

| Size | Letter spacing | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| 96px and up | -0.045em | posters, the giant footer wordmark |
| 64–95px | -0.035em | display |
| 48–63px | -0.03em | h2 |
| 32–47px | -0.025em | h3, closing lines |
| 24–31px | -0.02em | headlines on phones |
| 18–23px | -0.015em | h4, wordmark, quotes in cards |
| 16–17px | -0.01em | body-lg, lead, buttons |
| 15px and below | 0 | body, ui, small |
| Mono UPPERCASE 11.5px | +0.06em | label |
| Mono UPPERCASE 10.5px | +0.12em | micro |
| Mono mixed case | 0 | data |

**Weights, one job each.** 400: all running text. 500: headlines, big numbers and prices, bold words inside a headline or lead. 600: every button (primary, solid and ghost), H4, bold words inside body text. 700: the wordmark only. Never 300, never 800+.

**Allowed sizes.** Sans: 13, 14, 15, 16 (buttons and inputs), 17, 22px, plus the clamp() tokens above. Mono: 10.5, 11.5, 12px. No half-pixel sans sizes, no 18 or 19px. Nothing smaller than 13px for sans text.

**Eyebrows are mono.** Never spaced-out Inter Tight caps. Use `.mm-label` (11.5px, +0.06em) or `.mm-micro` (10.5px, +0.12em).

**OpenType.** Kerning, ligatures and contextual alternates on everywhere (`.mm` sets them). Tabular lining figures on every price, countdown, stat, table and timestamp (`.mm-num`, `.mm-stat`, `.mm-data`).

| Token | Features | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `--mm-features-text` | `"kern" 1, "liga" 1, "calt" 1` | Every text: kerning, ligatures and contextual alternates on. Set once on .mm. |
| `--mm-features-num` | `"tnum" 1, "lnum" 1` | Prices, stats, countdowns, tables, timestamps: tabular lining figures so digits line up and do not jump. |
| `--mm-features-caps` | `"case" 1, "cpsp" 1` | Rare all-caps sans (avoid): case-sensitive punctuation and capital spacing. |

**Line height and measure.** Display and H2 1.02–1.04, max about 16 characters per line. H3/H4 1.08–1.2. Lead 1.5, max 40ch. Body 1.5–1.55, max 65ch. Headlines `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs `text-wrap: pretty`. Mono labels never wrap.

**Punctuation.** Sentence case everywhere except mono labels (UPPERCASE). Curly quotes and apostrophes (’ “ ”). En dash for ranges (3–5 days). Non-breaking space between a number and its unit (5&nbsp;days). × for multiplication. One ellipsis character (…), rarely.

## 5. Layout and space

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--mm-gutter` | 28px | Side padding on every screen size (respect safe areas). |
| `--mm-content` | 1120px | Max width of section content. |
| `--mm-frame` | 1640px | Max width of the nav and full-bleed frames. |
| `--mm-nav-h` | 64px | Nav bar height. |
| `--mm-section-pt` | clamp(96px, 11vw, 160px) | Section padding top. |
| `--mm-section-pb` | clamp(96px, 10vw, 140px) | Section padding bottom. |
| `--mm-col-gap` | 64px | Gap between a section's two columns. |

Spacing scale (4px base): 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 32px, 44px, 56px, 64px, 96px, 128px.

Radius: xs 2px (editorial buttons inside client work only); sm 9px (small tiles, day cells); md 12px (browser windows, image frames); lg 16px (panels and benches); xl 18px (ticket / launch pass); 2xl 28px (large input boxes); pill 999px (buttons, chips, the prompt bar).

Section pattern: quiet mono label, two-tone H2, then a short lead paragraph to the right on desktop (stacks under 900px). Hairlines (`--mm-hair`) between rows instead of boxes. Wide frame (1640px) for the nav, narrow content (1120px) for sections.

## 6. Components (use these classes on websites)

Wrap the page in `<body class="mm">` and load `tokens.css` then `brand.css`. Then:

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.mm-label` | Mono UPPERCASE eyebrow with the orange square. `.is-quiet` drops the square and dims it. |
| `.mm-display`, `.mm-h2`, `.mm-h3`, `.mm-h4`, `.mm-stat` | Headline sizes. Wrap the first half in `<span class="mm-dim">` for two-tone. |
| `.mm-lead`, `.mm-body-lg`, `.mm-small`, `.mm-micro` | Text sizes. |
| `.mm-btn.is-primary` | Orange pill button, 52px tall, dark text. **One per view.** |
| `.mm-btn.is-solid` | Bone button on black (ink on paper). Nav button, important secondary action. |
| `.mm-btn.is-ghost` | Hairline outline button. |
| `.mm-btn.is-sm` | 34px small button. |
| `.mm-link` | Inline link with an orange underline. |
| `.mm-chip`, `.mm-input`, `.mm-error` | Filter chips, pill inputs, error text. |
| `.mm-panel` | Raised panel with a hairline ring, 16px radius. |
| `.mm-window` + `.mm-window-bar` | Browser window frame for showing real work. Client brands stay inside it. |
| `.mm-dots` | 24px dotted workbench background. |
| `.mm-live` | Pulsing round status dot. |
| `.mm-section`, `.mm-container`, `.mm-split`, `.mm-frame` | Layout. |
| `[data-theme="paper"]` | Switches any element (or the whole page) to the Paper theme. |

Buttons say what happens, in the first person for the main action: “Plan my launch”, “See what’s included”, “Build my idea”. Never “Get started”, “Learn more” or “Click here”.

Icons: 16px grid, 1.6px stroke, round caps and joins, no fills, `currentColor`. Use only the set in `docs/brand/icons/` (28 icons: arrow-right, arrow-up-right, arrow-down, chevron-down, check, plus, minus, close, menu, search, mail, chat, calendar, clock, ticket, window, layers, pen, video, play, chart, users, globe, lock, link, download, pin, info). Never a sparkle, magic wand, robot or brain.

## 7. Signature elements

- **The label square:** 5px orange square before every mono label.
- **Two-tone headline:** dim setup, bone payoff.
- **The launch pass:** a paper ticket (`#F3F0E8`, 18px radius) with an orange header strip, mono labels “FROM · TO”, IDEA → LIVE, and a price. Used for pricing, offers and receipts.
- **Dotted workbench:** `.mm-dots` behind build logs and panels.
- **Copper light curtain:** soft vertical copper streaks rising from the bottom. Hero sections and campaign covers only, never on every section.
- **Grain:** 5% white noise on full-bleed dark areas only.
- **Browser window:** real client work, at real size, in `.mm-window` with a real URL in the bar.

## 8. Imagery

- Show real work (in a browser window), real people and hands at work, and the textures above.
- Two photo grades only: **natural** (saturation about 72%, warm light) or **duotone** (black `#0A0A0C` to bone `#F4F4F1`). One grade per layout.
- Text over a photo always sits on a dark gradient.
- Never: sci-fi AI renders, robots, glowing brains, circuit boards, handshake stock, 3D blobs, neon gradients, device mockups with fake UI, invented client logos, orange-tinted photos, mascots.

### Image prompt library

Every image prompt is: **[subject] + brand style + aspect ratio + avoid list.** Use these as they are, or write a new subject in the same shape. Describe a real scene a photographer could shoot; name the light, not the mood.

Brand style (add to every prompt):

```
Documentary photograph, honest and unstaged. Natural window light with a warm desk lamp, muted colour (about 70% saturation), soft contrast, shadows that fall to near-black, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, fine film grain. Real, slightly lived-in workspace. Leave calm dark space on one side for a headline.
```

Always avoid:

```
text, letters, logos, watermarks, readable screens or UI, robots, glowing brains, circuit boards, holograms, neon, purple or blue gradients, 3D renders, lens flare, posed stock smiles, handshakes, extra fingers
```

Ready prompts:

In Midjourney, add `--ar <ratio> --style raw --stylize 50 --no <avoid list>`. In Firefly, Ideogram or Flux, set content type to Photo, effects off, and put the avoid list in the negative prompt.

After generating:

- For black layouts, convert to the duotone grade: black #0A0A0C to bone #F4F4F1 (Photoshop Gradient Map, Figma “Luminosity” blend over a black fill, or any duotone tool).
- For case studies and the founder’s own photos, keep the natural grade: saturation down to about 72%, no filters.
- Check hands, faces and edges at 100%. Reject anything with warped fingers, fake lettering or plastic skin.
- Crop so the subject sits on one third and the dark space holds the headline. Text over a photo always sits on the dark gradient.

Where generated images can’t go:

- Generated images are for mood, backgrounds, textures and editorial scenes.
- Never present a generated person as a real client, founder, team member or testimonial, and never use generated images in case studies. Those use real photos and real screenshots.
- Never generate our logo, a client’s logo or UI. Add type and screens afterwards in the layout.

## 9. Voice and copy

We write like a founder talking to a founder: short sentences, real numbers, no hype.

- **Headlines:** setup, then payoff. “One price. No surprises.”
- **Numbers:** exact and true. “$500 to set up, $200 a month.” “Live in five business days.” Never invent stats, testimonials, client names or “10x”.
- **Words we use:** launch, kit, pass, founder, live, yours.
- **Words we never use:** revolutionary, unlock, seamless, supercharge, cutting-edge, AI-powered, game-changer, elevate, leverage, world-class, pixel-perfect, and emoji.
- **The human line:** “designed by people”, word for word, everywhere. Never “made by people”, “human-led, AI-assisted” or “handcrafted”.
- **Names:** MuzMesh in text, muzmesh (lowercase) in the logo, MuzMesh Creative for the legal name. “Five days” in copy, “5 days” in labels.

Write: “A designer draws your logo, sets your brand and designs your page in Figma.”
Not: “Unlock your startup’s full potential with our AI-powered branding ✨”

## 10. Logo

- Files: `muzmesh-wordmark-light.svg` (bone, for black), `muzmesh-wordmark.svg` (ink, for paper or orange), `muzmesh-avatar.svg` (square “m.” for profiles), `muzmesh-favicon.svg`.
- Always use the files. If you cannot, set “muzmesh” lowercase in Inter Tight 700 at −0.015em, bone on black or ink on paper.
- Minimum width 72px. Clear space equal to the height of the “m”.
- Never orange, never a gradient, glow or outline, never next to a sparkle, never capitalised, stretched or re-tracked.

## 11. Recipes

### A web page or section

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="brand.css">
</head>
<body class="mm">
  <section class="mm-section">
    <div class="mm-container mm-split">
      <div>
        <span class="mm-label">Pricing</span>
        <h2 class="mm-h2"><span class="mm-dim">One price.</span> No surprises.</h2>
      </div>
      <p class="mm-lead">$500 to set up, then $200 a month from the month after launch.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="mm-container" style="margin-top:56px">
      <a class="mm-btn is-primary" href="#plan">Plan my launch</a>
      <a class="mm-btn is-ghost" href="#included">See what’s included</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</body>
</html>
```

With Tailwind v4, import `tailwind-theme.css` and use `bg-mm-bg text-mm-text font-sans`, `text-mm-muted`, `bg-mm-accent text-mm-on-accent`.

If you cannot load the files, paste the CSS variables from section 12 into a `<style>` block and use them directly.

### A social post (1080×1350, 4:5)

- Black background (or Paper for contrast, or a duotone photo with a dark gradient).
- 86px margin. Mono label top left with the orange square. Two-tone headline, Inter Tight 500, about 100px, tracking −0.03em, max three lines. Wordmark bottom left, slide number or “Swipe →” bottom right in mono.
- One idea per post. Carousels: cover, point, list, proof, call to action; 6 to 8 slides.
- Feed mix: about half black, a quarter duotone photos, a quarter Paper. Never an orange background post.
- Captions: the first line is the headline, short sentences, one link, at most three hashtags at the end, alt text on every image.

### Sizes

| Asset | Size |
|---|---|
| Feed post, carousel slide | 1080×1350 |
| Square post (X, Facebook) | 1080×1080 |
| Story, reel cover | 1080×1920 (keep the top 250px and bottom 340px clear) |
| Link preview (OG) | 1200×630 |
| LinkedIn banner | 1584×396 (text starts 30% from the left) |
| X header | 1500×500 |
| Avatar | 800×800 |
| YouTube thumbnail | 1280×720 |
| Fiverr gig image | 1280×769 |

### A deck

Black slides, one headline per slide (two-tone), a mono label and slide number, lots of space. Paper slides for tables and pricing. 16:9.

### A document, proposal or invoice

Paper theme: `#F3F0E8` page, ink `#1D1D1F` text, muted `#595857`. Mono UPPERCASE labels, Inter Tight headings. Orange text or thin lines on paper use `#B33A06`. Use the launch pass for the price block. A4 or Letter.

### An email

Plain and short. Name, MuzMesh, one link in the signature. No image banners.

## 12. CSS variables (paste-ready)

```css
/* MuzMesh brand tokens v2. Generated by docs/brand/build-tokens.mjs: edit that file, not this one.
   Two themes: Launch (default, dark) and Paper (light). Set data-theme="paper" on <html> or any element to switch a subtree.
   Components use the --mm-* role tokens; the --mm-c-* core values are for art and one-off illustrations only. */
:root {
  --mm-c-black: #000000;
  --mm-c-raise-1: #0E0E10;
  --mm-c-raise-2: #141418;
  --mm-c-graphite: #2C2C35;
  --mm-c-bone: #F4F4F1;
  --mm-c-stone: #BDBDB8;
  --mm-c-ash: #77777C;
  --mm-c-paper: #F3F0E8;
  --mm-c-paper-2: #E8E4D9;
  --mm-c-paper-card: #FBFAF6;
  --mm-c-paper-line: #D9D4C7;
  --mm-c-ink: #1D1D1F;
  --mm-c-on-accent: #0E0E10;
  --mm-c-signal: #F2580F;
  --mm-c-signal-hot: #FF6A20;
  --mm-c-signal-deep: #CC3D08;
  --mm-c-signal-ink: #B33A06;
  --mm-c-danger-dark: #FF7A59;
  --mm-c-danger-light: #B42318;
  --mm-c-success-dark: #6FDC8C;
  --mm-c-success-light: #1F7A35;

  /* fonts */
  --mm-font-sans: "Inter Tight", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mm-font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace;

  /* type scale: size / weight / line-height / tracking */
  --mm-type-display: clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 72px); --mm-type-display-w: 500; --mm-type-display-lh: 1.02; --mm-type-display-ls: -0.035em;
  --mm-type-h2: clamp(34px, 3.7vw, 56px); --mm-type-h2-w: 500; --mm-type-h2-lh: 1.04; --mm-type-h2-ls: -0.03em;
  --mm-type-h3: clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px); --mm-type-h3-w: 500; --mm-type-h3-lh: 1.08; --mm-type-h3-ls: -0.025em;
  --mm-type-h4: 22px; --mm-type-h4-w: 600; --mm-type-h4-lh: 1.2; --mm-type-h4-ls: -0.015em;
  --mm-type-stat: clamp(44px, 4.6vw, 64px); --mm-type-stat-w: 500; --mm-type-stat-lh: 1; --mm-type-stat-ls: -0.04em;
  --mm-type-lead: clamp(17px, 1.35vw, 20px); --mm-type-lead-w: 400; --mm-type-lead-lh: 1.5; --mm-type-lead-ls: -0.01em;

  --mm-type-body: 15px; --mm-type-body-w: 400; --mm-type-body-lh: 1.55; --mm-type-body-ls: 0;
  --mm-type-button: 16px; --mm-type-button-w: 600; --mm-type-button-lh: 1; --mm-type-button-ls: -0.01em;
  --mm-type-ui: 14px; --mm-type-ui-w: 400; --mm-type-ui-lh: 1.45; --mm-type-ui-ls: 0;
  --mm-type-small: 13px; --mm-type-small-w: 400; --mm-type-small-lh: 1.45; --mm-type-small-ls: 0;
  --mm-type-label: 11.5px; --mm-type-label-w: 400; --mm-type-label-lh: 1.2; --mm-type-label-ls: 0.06em;
  --mm-type-micro: 10.5px; --mm-type-micro-w: 500; --mm-type-micro-lh: 1.2; --mm-type-micro-ls: 0.12em;
  --mm-type-data: 12px; --mm-type-data-w: 400; --mm-type-data-lh: 1.5; --mm-type-data-ls: 0;
  --mm-type-wordmark: 22px; --mm-type-wordmark-w: 700; --mm-type-wordmark-lh: 1; --mm-type-wordmark-ls: -0.015em;
  --mm-features-text: "kern" 1, "liga" 1, "calt" 1;
  --mm-features-num: "tnum" 1, "lnum" 1;
  --mm-features-caps: "case" 1, "cpsp" 1;

  /* space (4px base) */
  --mm-space-1: 4px;
  --mm-space-2: 8px;
  --mm-space-3: 12px;
  --mm-space-4: 16px;
  --mm-space-5: 20px;

  /* layout */
  --mm-gutter: 28px;
  --mm-content: 1120px;
  --mm-frame: 1640px;
  --mm-nav-h: 64px;
  --mm-section-pt: clamp(96px, 11vw, 160px);
  --mm-section-pb: clamp(96px, 10vw, 140px);
  --mm-col-gap: 64px;

  /* radius */
  --mm-radius-xs: 2px;
  --mm-radius-sm: 9px;
  --mm-radius-md: 12px;
  --mm-radius-lg: 16px;
  --mm-radius-xl: 18px;
  --mm-radius-2xl: 28px;
  --mm-radius-pill: 999px;

  /* shadow */
  --mm-shadow-ring: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,244,241,.14);
  --mm-shadow-window: 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,244,241,.14), 0 40px 100px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
  --mm-shadow-glow: 0 18px 50px -14px rgba(242,88,15,.6);
  --mm-shadow-focus: 0 0 0 4px rgba(242,88,15,.14);

  /* motion */
  --mm-dur-fast: 150ms;
  --mm-dur-base: 200ms;
  --mm-dur-slow: 700ms;
  --mm-ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --mm-ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1);
}

/* Launch theme (default) */
:root, [data-theme="launch"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --mm-bg: #000000;
  --mm-surface: #0E0E10;

/* Paper theme */
[data-theme="paper"] {
  color-scheme: light;

}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  :root { --mm-dur-fast: 0ms; --mm-dur-base: 0ms; --mm-dur-slow: 0ms; }
}
```

## 13. Check before you hand it over

- [ ] Only colours from section 3. No new hex values.
- [ ] Only Inter Tight and JetBrains Mono.
- [ ] Type comes from the scale in section 4: allowed sizes, the tracking for that size, weights 400/500/600 (700 only for the wordmark), tabular figures on numbers.
- [ ] One orange primary button per view, with dark text on it.
- [ ] Every section starts with a mono label; headlines are two-tone.
- [ ] Text contrast at least 4.5:1 (use the pairs in section 3).
- [ ] No emoji, sparkles, robots or gradients on text. Generated images use the prompt library and aren’t shown as real people or work.
- [ ] Copy is short and every number is true.
- [ ] Works at 360px wide with no sideways scroll; respects reduced motion.

Run `node docs/brand/ai/check-brand.mjs <file>` on any HTML or CSS file to catch off-brand colours, fonts, off-scale type sizes, letter spacing and weights, emoji and banned words.
